text: Neural sync holding. [pause 0.3] Don't do anything sudden for a day or two.
Hm? [pause 0.3] Oh. You. Any headaches, double vision, phantom limbs?

decant.text: Ninety-four percent fidelity on the first pass, which is better than the paperwork deserved. [pause 0.4] The gaps fill in. Mostly. Don't go looking for them.

gaps.text: Whatever the recorder missed. Names, faces, the last few minutes before the boarding. [pause 0.5] ~Nobody misses the last few minutes.~

tablet.text: Your numbers. Hannah's numbers. The station's numbers. [pause 0.4] Somebody has to keep score, and Hannah rounds up.
